title: Relay Demo — "Project Atlas" Q3 Launch Review
intro:
This is a showcase board. It exercises every question type (single, multi, yes/no, scale, text, textarea) and every visual block type (markdown, chart, table, mermaid, graphviz, plantuml, code, html, image).

**Try the interactions:** hover a chart point, a diagram node, or a table cell to leave an inline comment; select text in any prose to annotate it; and click **Edit** on the architecture diagram to revise it yourself. Answers autosave as you go.

blocks.md:
## 📊 Where we stand
Atlas hit **GA-readiness** last sprint. Below is the launch dashboard the steering group will review. Everything on this page is annotatable — *select this sentence* to leave a margin note.

options.label: Big Bang
options.description: Ship to 100% on launch day. Maximum momentum, maximum risk.

blocks.html:

options.description: 10% → 50% → 100% over 3 weeks with canary gates. Balanced.

questions.label: Which launch channels should be in scope for week 1?
Does this canary promotion sequence look right?

blocks.code:
@startuml
actor Operator
participant "Deploy bot" as Bot
participant "Canary 10%" as Canary
participant "Fleet 100%" as Fleet
Operator -> Bot: promote()
Bot -> Canary: route 10% traffic
Canary --> Bot: metrics OK (30m)
Bot -> Fleet: ramp to 100%
Fleet --> Operator: launch complete
@enduml
